$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs. Emitted as --c-*. Each aliases a semantic token or holds a per-component size. Only tokens that core @unicron/ui primitives read belong here; app-specific components keep theirs in the app extension layer.

icon.$description: Material Symbols variable-font axes. The Icon component reads these; a parent can override them (e.g. an active nav item sets --c-icon-fill: 1).

grad.$description: Dark surfaces look heavier, so grade icons down slightly (Material guidance).

app-frame.$description: AppFrame: the outermost box of an app that fills the screen, with its header, its nav, and the strips beside the notch and home bar.

edge.$description: Header, nav and the strips at the screen's edges. One colour, so the bars seem to reach the edges.

nav-height.$description: The floating capsule, along the bottom: a 44px item in 4px of padding.

nav-item-width.$description: Each place in the capsule along the bottom.

nav-gap.$description: Around the floating nav, and its least distance from the screen's edge.

rail-width.$description: The same nav as a pill down the side, when height is scarce.

pivot-width.$description: AppFramePivot, the column of top-level places on a large screen.

sidebar-width.$description: AppFrameSidebar, the list beside the content.

dialog.$description: Dialog and Sheet popups (DialogContent, CommandDialog, SheetContent, AdaptiveSheetContent). From the sm breakpoint up a dialog fits its content between its size's min-width and max-width, and never gets wider than the screen less 1rem each side. Each size's min-width is the fixed width it had before, so no dialog got narrower.

titlebar-inset.$description: Height of the app's own title bar at the top of the window (a desktop app with the native title bar hidden). The popups keep clear of it: a dialog centres in the area below it; a side or top sheet starts under it. 0px for a web page or a window with a native title bar. Set it with beforeContent, the slot that holds the app's drag strip.

padding.$description: The space inside DialogContent. DialogFooter reads it too: it reaches out by it to run edge to edge, pads its buttons by it so they line up with the content, and a sticky footer pins by it. Change a dialog's padding by setting this (className="[--c-dialog-padding:1.5rem]"), not with a p-* class, so the footer still reaches the edges.

xs.$description: Very narrow. Allowed only for one short sentence (or none), at most two one-word actions and at most one short field (a PIN, a 6-digit code). The rule is in docs/03-components.md, Dialog widths.

menu.$description: Popup lists: DropdownMenuContent and DropdownMenuSubContent. A list sized apart from its trigger (width="fit" or "auto") stays between these two widths, so it never gets too narrow or too wide; past max-width its items wrap.

min-width.$description: The narrowest a list gets, whatever its trigger (Tailwind's min-w-32, the floor it always had).

max-width.$description: The widest a list sized by its items gets. A list that matches its trigger (width="trigger") follows the trigger instead.

popover.$description: PopoverContent. It never outgrows the space on screen, whatever this says.

width.$description: Its width (Tailwind's w-72, the shadcn default). For one wider popover, set the variable in its className.

sheet.$description: Adaptive sheet: a bottom sheet on phones, a side panel from the sm breakpoint up.

wide-width.$description: The wide variant (AdaptiveSheetContent wide), for a photo or other content that needs room.

skeleton.$description: Skeleton (packages/ui skeleton.tsx): the placeholder while content loads.

row-height.$description: Skeleton variant="row": one list row, as tall as an Item size="sm" with one line. An app with a density setting re-maps it to its own row height.

code.$description: CodeDisplay (docs/specs/security/code-display.md): one-time codes grouped for reading, with a time-remaining ring.

expiring-at.$description: Seconds left at which the code turns to the expiring state.

next-at.$description: Seconds left at which the next code appears beneath the current one.

copy-next-at.$description: Seconds left under which copy takes the next code instead.

rollover-duration.$description: Literal; tier 2 has no duration role.

large-type.$description: LargeTypeView (docs/specs/security/large-type-view.md): a secret full screen, grouped in threes, for reading across a room.

crown-jewel.$description: CrownJewel treatment (docs/specs/security/crown-jewel-treatment.md): the surface re-maps the semantic roles for its subtree onto these, the way .dark does.

surface.$description: Assigned to --background and --card inside the surface.

muted-ink.$description: Assigned to --muted-foreground inside (not in the spec's table; needed so hints keep contrast on the inverted surface).

risk-tier.$description: RiskTierBadge (docs/specs/security/risk-tier-badge.md): one word, one icon, one colour per trust tier.

official-bg.$description: Text stays {foreground} for contrast; only the icon takes the ink.

secret-field.$description: SecretField (docs/specs/security/secret-field.md): a hidden value with a bounded reveal and a timed copy.

mask-count.$description: Dots in read mode, never the true length.

clipboard-timer.$description: Default; a host may override within 10–90 s.

status-orb.$description: StatusOrb: one glanceable state (idle, thinking, working, needs-you, done, failed, offline), told apart by shape and motion as well as these colours. Dots, halos and rings take the status fills; the done and failed glyphs take the text inks.

size-xs.$description: A step in a run trace.

size-md.$description: A nav item, a hero. The icon's 20px optical size.

indicator.$description: The attention or unread mark on an AppFrameNavItem or an Item: a dot, or a count badge on the bottom bar.

attention.$description: The dot, and the badge's edge.

unread.$description: The dot, and the badge's fill.

attention-badge-bg.$description: The count reads Lc 75 on it in --attention-foreground.

progress.$description: Progress: a determinate bar, or one cell per step (segmented). The track is --muted; each fill is a solid held to Lc 30 against it (scripts/contrast.mjs).

complete.$description: The fill once value reaches max (not for a budget).

agent-prompt.$description: AgentPrompt (docs/specs/security/agent-prompt.md): an agent's question in the conversation, with an attention edge while it waits.

edge-color.$description: While it waits on the person. Lc 44 on a card (light), 70 (dark).

edge-answered.$description: Once answered: quiet, so only open questions stand out.

approval.$description: ApprovalSheet (docs/specs/security/approval-sheet.md): approve or deny a request from another device, with number matching, an arming delay, and a timeout that denies.

min-width.$description: Never smaller than this at any breakpoint.

arm-delay.$description: Inert window after open. The component reads it at runtime and falls back to 500ms without the stylesheet.
